Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-linux/

The Linux kernel as pinned files: kernel.toml pins (mainline, stable, CachyOS) against kernel.org releases.json, shallow sparse submodule sync, and a tree-sitter code graph of the kernel source in one SQLite file; ships `fw-linux` (run by `fw kernel`)
